summary: Reminders fit long assignment names, school blocks point to a page for IT, and Mascot uses less battery.
highlights: Reminders with long assignment names now show the Snooze and Open buttons.
The reminder bubble floats above the Dock instead of sitting behind it.
When your school blocks Classroom, Mascot links a page you can send to your school's IT.
Sign-in stops waiting after 2 minutes if Google has blocked it.
Uses less battery while idle, and pauses its animation when your screen is off.
Works with the Dock on the left or right side of the screen.
Mascot Studio is put away for now, while the pack tools are finished.
